user.title: Set up Gaian Grid Telemetry
user.description: Enter your Gaian Grid enrollment token and choose the electricity sensors you can share. Not all sensors are required, but whole-grid voltage, frequency, and power are preferred when available. Even a single voltage sensor from a smart plug helps. Use either whole-grid net power sensors with positive import and negative export, or separate whole-grid import and export sensors. Additional power sensors are allowed, but they are not used as whole-grid import/export totals.

data.grid_voltage_entity_ids: Grid voltage sensors (V). Multiple can be provided if present and will be averaged. If you have a sensor directly at your grid coupling, just use this one. Otherwise multiple (if multiple smart plugs with voltage sensors we will take the average).
data.grid_net_power_entity_ids: Grid total net power sensors (W, import positive / export negative)

reauth.title: Refresh Gaian Grid credentials
reauth.description: Enter a fresh enrollment token to rotate the broker credentials for this Gaian Grid site.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Gaian Grid telemetry
reconfigure.description: Update the local Gaian Grid sensor selection and publish intervals. Whole-grid voltage, frequency, and power are preferred when available. Even a single voltage sensor still helps.

data.grid_net_power_entity_ids: Whole-grid net power sensors (W, import positive / export negative)

error.hub_timeout: Timed out waiting for the hub to respond.
error.invalid_enrollment_response: The hub returned an invalid enrollment response.
error.invalid_enrollment_token: The enrollment token is invalid, expired, revoked, or already used.

error.unsupported_frequency_selection: Grid frequency sensors must use Hz.
